name: handoff
description: When a chat gets very long, writes a handoff of the whole chat (what was asked, what is done, files to open, next steps), shows the steps with progress bars, then copies it or starts a fresh chat with it. Works at a token limit you choose, or any time with /handoff.

auto_offer.title: Offer a handoff automatically
auto_offer.description: Show the Refresh offer when the chat gets long. Turn off to only use /handoff and /refresh.

offer_at_tokens.title: Offer at (tokens)
offer_at_tokens.description: Offer a handoff when the chat holds this many tokens. It is capped at 80% of the model's window, so it still shows on a smaller window.

snooze_tokens.title: Ask again after (tokens)
snooze_tokens.description: After you press Not now or Close, ask again once the chat has grown by this many tokens.

max_words.title: Handoff length (words)
max_words.description: The most words the handoff should have.

extra_instructions.title: Extra rules for every handoff
extra_instructions.description: Optional. One or two sentences added to every handoff request, for example: Always name the Shopify store and the theme branch.

save_folder.title: Save handoffs in
save_folder.description: Folder for saved handoffs. Leave empty to use ~/.claude/handoffs.

new_chat_in_same_folder.title: New chat opens in the same folder
new_chat_in_same_folder.description: When Start new chat uses the Claude app link, open it in this chat's folder.

use_pet.title: Use Claude Pet when it is running
use_pet.description: If Claude Pet is running, let it start the new chat instead of the app link.

fallback_model.title: Fallback model
fallback_model.description: Used only when the chat cannot be reused for the handoff (for example right after a resume). It is sent a trimmed copy of the chat.
